method: served_seconds / faithful are EXECUTED, not transcribed: the worktree adapters were imported with tsx and servedIntervalMs(tf) + isTimeframeFaithful(venue, tf) evaluated for every pair (probe script served_probe.ts, env ALGOVAULT_TF_SKIP_ENABLED unset = kill switch default ON, tf-support.ts:60-62). Pair list = every (exchange, timeframe) in hold_decisions WHERE raw_final IS NOT NULL (sql/q02_venue_tf.sql).

definitions.served_seconds: finest base candle the adapter FETCHES for tf (served-interval.ts:1-17; no adapter aggregates, served-interval.ts:12-16)
definitions.W: EVAL_CANDLES[tf] (directional-labeler.ts:11-15), counted in SERVED bars by the race (directional-labeler.ts:126 forwardAsc.slice(0, W))
definitions.race_end: ceil(decided_at/served)*served + W*served (first forward bar = first bar with open time >= decided_at, backfill-hold-decision-labels.ts:478)

labeler_fetch_caveats: backfill-hold-decision-labels.ts:380 advances the page cursor by TF_MS[tf] (requested) and :465 resumes a group at coveredUntil + TF_MS[tf]: when served != tf a served bar whose open time falls in that gap is never cached, so a forward or trailing series can contain a hole and the W-th forward bar can close later than race_end. The maturity predicate on race_end is therefore NECESSARY, not sufficient, for the 25 fallback pairs; holes are not detectable without re-fetching candles.

served > tf (3m -> 5m on GATE, MEXC, HTX, PHEMEX, WEEX, XT): see labeler_truncation on those entries - label-0 races are never written, so any P(decided | X) fitted with venue x tf information has a structural shortcut there.

labeler_truncation.what: backfill-hold-decision-labels.ts:463 fetches only to decided_at + (W+2) x TF_MS[tf] (requested tf), and :476 caches nothing later; a served bar longer than tf therefore leaves at most floor(((W+2)*180)/300)+1 = 9 forward bars < W = 12. :490 then DROPS every label-0 race (forwardAsc.length < W), so this cell can only ever hold races that hit a barrier inside the truncated window: timeouts are never written, by construction.
